verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships a first-party Repository Agent, an AI assistant you talk to in conversation. The docs say you can ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push, which covers the core repository operations through natural language. The homepage also advertises a 'Code Agent' with opt-in data handling. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the agent's command coverage and limits (e.g. branching, merging, conflict resolution, settings), and any independent or hands-on corroboration that it works as described.
